name: sermcp
description: Inspect and control embedded devices through a managed serial console.

interface.shortDescription: Check, control, and troubleshoot embedded devices over serial
interface.longDescription: Connects to the embedded device configured by the project's .target.jsonc file. Check whether it is online or booting, read serial and boot messages, run supported commands, restart it, enter U-Boot, and investigate startup failures.
defaultPrompt: Check whether the configured device is online and show its latest serial output
Find out why the configured device did not finish booting
Restart the configured device and tell me when its console is ready
